a.text: The word means 'one without roots' in an ancient language.
My people say that all things are uncertain, except life and death. Trying to cling onto something only brings trouble.
That's why we drifted from one place to another, living with the barrenlands. There is always water and game to be found, and at the end of our lives, we return to dust, return to the earth.
But a Catastrophe destroyed our camp, and most of us lost our lives in the migration.
A woman from a nomadic city happened to pass by, and guided us to safety.
She taught us how to fight, shared knowledge, and told us stories of the cities.
She said that everyone should have a place to call home.

steps.text: Stay down.

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: (Ancient Sarkaz language) Who are you? Why am I here?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Can't understand a word. Not that it matters.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: You're here to heal your wounds. You'll do exactly as the doc says, if you want to see the sun rise again. If the don't want to die here, do as I say.

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: (In hesitant Yanese) Where am I... who are you?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: This is an infirmary and you're a patient. I'm a helper at the infirmary.

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: Where's my sword?!
The girl reaches around her in a panic, only calming down when she finds the weapon beside her.

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: It's there... thank goodness...

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: We found you passed out at the door of the infirmary yesterday, but you wouldn't let the sword go. Did you get hurt fighting over it?

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: ...Doesn't concern you.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: No need to look at me like that. I could've taken it while you were passed out, if I wanted to.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: I've seen so many people die over so-called masterwork weapons.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Did you really think wielding a weapon like that would make you strong enough to beat enemies you couldn't?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: I don't trust weapons. The only thing I trust is my fists.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: A true warrior shouldn't entrust victory to something else.

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: You don't understand!

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: I'm not trying to fight with this sword... I... I want to repay a debt.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: The sword is a weapon for killing.

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: My mentor told me the sword means a lot to her.

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: I promised her that I would bring her the sword, or bring it to her grave at least.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Has your mentor passed away?

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Well, I'm not interested in listening to people talk about their debts and grudges.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: If you say you fought over the sword to repay a debt, I'll believe it. A woman who's almost died has no need to lie.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: So it means you see your obligations as being more important than your life. That's not a bad thing.

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: Why did you help me?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: What's an infirmary for, if not to help people?

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: But I don't have any money. I know that money is required in exchange for kindness in the nomadic cities.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: That's not wrong, but you can work your debt off as well. Why do you think I'm working here for the doc?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: The difference is that I'm working to pay the medical bills of the people I beat up.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: I do the heavy lifting at the clinic, so you should learn to do things like drying herbs and wrapping wounds. You don't owe as much as I do. A few months should be enough to pay your debt off.

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: I will find a way to repay your kindness, but I am in a hurry...

steps.name: Injured Girl
steps.text: I need to get out of the city.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: You're not going anywhere.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: I said, stay down. You're here to get your injuries healed.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: You managed to survive them. Would be a shame if you died now. Not to mention an embarrassment to the clinic.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: But... kindness is important too. I'll think about it... once you're healed up and repaid your debt.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Another patient?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: I'll take a look. STAY, DOWN.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Are you the doctor, sir?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: The doc's out. I'm a helper here. I can help you, if you just want meds, but you'll have to wait if you want the doc to look at you.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I apologize for the interruption. We are investigating a case and pursuing a suspect. Here is my token. We would appreciate your cooperation in answering a few questions.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Ask what you want. I'll decide if I want to answer.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Has this clinic treated or seen anyone who suffered serious a stab wound?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Nope and nope. Either you're buying, or you go find someone else to bother.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I would like to take a quick look. It'll only take a minute.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Nope, patients and customers only.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I have nothing but the greatest respect for the clinic's work. I would rather not have to force my way in.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But this concerns the safety of all of Yumen. Your cooperation would be appreciated.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: You got your rules, I got mine. You ain't coming in unless I say so.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Then I apologize.
Zuo Le's movements are swift as a fowlbeast.
But he feels a hand on his collar just as he is about to cross the clinic's threshold, throwing him backwards.
The burly man continues to stand there, as though he has never moved.
It is as though the fowlbeast flew into an invisible and boundless net.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (This man is no ordinary brute!)

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: I said, you ain't coming in! You got a death wish, kid?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Do you understand the consequences of obstructing justice?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Don't understand, don't care.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Try that again, I dare you.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Enough! This is not a game.

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Huh...?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: There's someone else in there?!

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Hm? Hey, where did the girl go?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What the...?
Bandages and cotton balls are scattered on the table, and the bed is still warm.
The air smells of blood and herbal medicine.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You said no heavily wounded patients were taken in lately.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: How do you explain the gauze and blood?

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Aiya! I told her to stay put!

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: She said she needed to get out of the city. She must be headed to the gates!

steps.name: Burly Man
steps.text: Oh no, I've gotta catch her, or the doc's gonna put her bill on my tab!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Stop right there!

steps.name: Cheerful Shouting
steps.text: Tea leaves! Shangshu rock tea, Kou-wu flower tea, Jiangqi white tea, Dahuang raw leaves... anything you want, I've got it here!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Two carts of Lungmen green tea.

steps.name: Hawker
steps.text: E-Excuse me, miss, but we don't sell tea by the cart...

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: M-

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: Miss...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We meet again.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Any updates on what I asked you to look into?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We agreed on terms.

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: I... I don't know what you mean...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: How many caravans in this batch are carrying false permits? How did they get those permits?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I need to know more.

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: I-I'll pay the taxes I owe! The whole amount! Please, don't ask any more questions!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: We can talk about your previous offenses another day.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Answer my question.

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: H-Help!

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: Thief!

steps.name: Angry Passerby
steps.text: You've got nerve, stealing in broad daylight!

steps.name: Helpful Passerby
steps.text: Grab her!

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You test my patience.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: Watch out! I saw an accomplice go that way!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Excuse me...

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: The owner is out. You need something made?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I just have a couple of questions.

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: This is a smithy. The inn's where you go for gossip.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I hear there are some old jianghu kung fu stories that only circulate here.

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: Fine, I guess it can't hurt to have someone to chat with while I work. Fire away.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I really ought to buy something for your trouble.

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: What d'ya want? Frying pan? Kitchen knife?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: How about a sword?

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: Sorry, can't do that. Household items only.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But the sign on the door says 'Sword Forge'.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: This is probably the last place in Yumen that still uses that particular wording.

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: It's just a name. The owner could change it to 'The Tea Parlor' or 'The Guest House' if he wanted.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: You're not from around here, are you? Tourist?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I've wanted to see the deserts of Yumen for a long time.

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: We get a bunch of tourists every time we link up with Lungmen thanks to the wuxia TV shows. Anyone with half a brain should know that it's all fake.

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: What's so good about this backwater place?

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: Did you want a souvenir sword? Trust me, you're better off getting a pack or two of Yumen jerky.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Every place has its own unique scenery. It's always worth a look.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Setting aside whether the TV shows are fake or not, I'm sure there's a story behind this smithy.

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: Sure of that, are you?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I don't mean to offend, but every shop I passed by on my way from the market was full of people... except this one.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Why would a shop with no history or business be on a busy street like this?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And I doubt a shop that really has no business would have so many furnaces burning and so many iron ingots lying around.

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: This is why I hate talking to smart people. Makes my head hurt.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I'll take that as a compliment.

steps.name: Blacksmith
steps.text: Alright, what do you want to know?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I wanted to ask you about stories from the world of kung fu... but you've piqued my interest in something else.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: How did 'The Sword Forge' become a smithy?
A man running for his life can always find an extra burst of speed.
Just as he is about to shake his pursuer, a rope appears out of nowhere, tripping him over. He tries to pull himself back up, only to find nothing but quicksand around him.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Had enough yet?

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: (Gasps for air, exhausted)

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Good. Now we can talk.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What are you afraid of?

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: This... this group is different...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: T-They'll have my head if I talk...

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: I have a family... they're counting on me to feed them... please...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: I'm glad you remember that you have family. Let me remind you...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: They're all in Lungmen.

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: You—!

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: Miss Lin, I know how you and the Rat King operate...

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: Y-You wouldn't...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: That's up to you.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Or do I really need to prove to you what I'm capable of?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Tell me what you know.

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: The smugglers that make the rounds when Lungmen and Yumen link up are usually pretty consistent. The same groups, working with the same forgers, same suppliers, same fences.

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: This time around, though, there's a new group that nobody knows anything about, not even the oldest crooks. Some tried to pick a fight... and nobody ever saw them again.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: The new smugglers disappeared?

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: No, the ones who picked the fight...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: What else do you know?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Out with it.

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: I've heard, well, rumors about where they hide and sell their stuff...

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: You took care of things at the market?

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: Nothing a few coins couldn't fix.

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Lungmen Agent
steps.text: And this man...?

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Take him to the barracks, then back to the L.G.D. after we're done here in Yumen.

steps.name: Agitated Hawker
steps.text: I-I told you everything I know! Why—

steps.name: Lin Yühsia
steps.text: Quit complaining, it's for your own safety.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: He just disappeared?
The markets of Yumen are not usually so busy.
The streets are packed with people, and parents hold their children's hands a little tighter.
It is not easy trying to find someone in this crowd.
Are you buying or not?!
Get out of the way if you're not buying! You're in everybody's way!

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Sorry...
The noise of people shouting, arguing and bartering drowns out deadlier sounds.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: What the—?!
The sword comes from behind, without a sound.
Zuo Le takes a step forward, almost by instinct.
The point of the sword tears through his clothes, inches from leaving behind a wound that would have crippled him for life.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Who's there?!
Zuo Le turns around, but sees only the bustling market.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (Did he intentionally draw me here?)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (A commotion here would...)

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: (Where are you?)

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The market sure is busy today, isn't it?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Mr. Lee?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Looks like we have some troublemakers in the crowd. Be careful.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I noticed. Did you...?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Just a little optical trick. Won't last long.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's dangerous here. We should leave.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No choice, I suppose...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Turns out we're the ones who fell into a trap.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Let's get out of here. We don't want civilians getting hurt.
